criteria.rationale: The patient was 56 on the 2026-09-01 request date, meeting the age-18 minimum.
The request is for initial Wegovy treatment for chronic weight management.
The latest structured BMI before the request was 38.2 kg/m², above the 30 kg/m² threshold.

The patient participated in a dietitian-led program involving food logging, calorie reduction, and walking. He later stopped and was not following a plan in August, but the policy accepts past participation without a minimum duration or ongoing-enrollment requirement.
No other GLP-1 therapy is documented among the active medications. The draft Wegovy order is the treatment under review, not concurrent therapy.
No other Appendix 2 PA weight-loss medication is documented among the active medications. The draft Wegovy order is excluded from the concurrent-therapy assessment.

Stopping the program does not negate past participation under this policy.
